is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles funestus field isolates from the DRC (page 1).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports genotyping for Ace-1 N485I (N643I in the paper), and various SNPs in CYP6P4, GSTe2, and vgsc (Table 1, page 4).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 1 provides allele frequencies (Reference/Non-reference) and sample numbers for non-synonymous variants (page 4).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from households in two sites in Sud-Kivu province, DRC (page 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study developing and applying an amplicon sequencing panel to field-collected mosquitoes.

sub_country_location.evidence: Samples were collected from Tchonka and Tushunguti in Sud-Kivu province, DRC (page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collection dates are specified as Tchonka: April–June 2018; Tushunguti: December 2017–February 2018 (page 2).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a new amplicon sequencing panel and reports new data from 80 field-collected mosquitoes.

supplement.evidence: The necessary genotype data is provided in Table 1 of the main text.

assessment.summary: This study developed a targeted amplicon sequencing panel to screen 80 Anopheles funestus field isolates from the DRC for insecticide resistance markers. It identified the Ace-1 N485I mutation and several novel SNPs in CYP6P4, GSTe2, and vgsc genes, along with a previously known 2bp insertion in the CYP6P9a promoter.
